text: 2026-09-23 architecture consensus Fray75 seq712/713/714, confirmed by lead: preserve two distinct producer seams, complete mapping results versus local evidence scores, converging on the existing checked result/exchange family. Direct categorical producers must not require a fake HsmmResult or invented DecisionBasis. Existing DerivationBinding.of/UnitOutcome.computed coupling requires a concrete truthful extension proposal from root+codex-temporal; this note is agreed design, not implemented support. Bind selected/rendered evidence separately from acquired/observed channel coverage; keep typed outcomes, empirical frequencies, calibration and protocol strata distinct. Declared input restrictions do not prove absence of learned priors.
